const int MODULUS_CONST = 998244353;

vector<int> list_factors(long long n) {
    vector<int> factors;
    for (long long i = 1; i * i <= n; ++i) {
        if (n % i == 0) {
            factors.push_back(i);
            if (i != n / i) {
                factors.push_back(n / i);
            }
        }
    }
    sort(factors.begin(), factors.end());
    return factors;
}

long long compute_inverse(long long n) {
    long long result = 1;
    long long power = MODULUS_CONST - 2;
    long long base = n % MODULUS_CONST;
    while (power > 0) {
        if (power & 1) result = (result * base) % MODULUS_CONST;
        base = (base * base) % MODULUS_CONST;
        power >>= 1;
    }

}
